names.note: Name page of days.pravoslavie.ru for this memory is «Леонид (Викторов), протоиерей, сщмч.»; the grade, the rank and, where there is one, the see are stripped and the surname kept, the day line itself giving only the forename. `fk.mjs` on the stored string returns NONE.

death.note: The day line closes «(1937)», which is the whole of what the source gives; no year of birth anywhere.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 28 декабря ст. ст. — «Сщмчч. Феоктиста , Леонида , Николая пресвитеров (1937).»

attestations.note: THE LINE AND THE NAME PAGE ARE ALL THERE IS: no life page stands behind this entry. The line names three men and all three are in this draft. A Cyrillic grep for «Викторов» over every `saint.json` returns `michael-viktorov`, another forename and another day, and `eutychius-kachur`, where the surname stands in prose.  The day page prints two hymns and both belong to the twenty thousand martyrs of Nicomedia; nothing stands under this name.
